description: Riders agree: Nothing comes close to Cyberbike's combination of price, power, and quality Order online for fast delivery Until now, if you wanted an electric bike, your choices have been underperforming, heavy, fat tire beach bikes, or legacy brands charging over $4000 or more. Now you have a logical choice, the Cyberbike Frisco. The mid drive powerhouse in a lightweight, high quality alloy chassis that really performs. Why do you want mid-drive instead of other bikes' hub drive? Simple: only a mid drive bike can use the bike's gears for what the engineers call "mechanical advantage." And only Cyberbike offers a heavy-duty alloy chassis, real full suspension with quality, name-brand components throughout, in an affordable mid drive electric bike, that's mountain-ready, right out of the box!
